g.text: 19. leaderless (closer-standing): the field engine, rung 0, "recruits", seed 1, 11.25 s to 599.75 s
the leader is down and the closer lives. Men: 9, 80. Body: hastati, first century.
+ a slot, joined to its man when he is away from it · □ the standard · ○ the men the flag is about · red line: a bout
